# limedl

> Fast multi-protocol download manager for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Rust engine, native Slint UI, HTTP AIMD concurrency, BitTorrent, CDN edge probing, and an Aria2-compatible JSON-RPC API.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://limedl.zkz098.cn/en/getting-started/overview/): design goals, architecture, and feature comparison.
- [Installation](https://limedl.zkz098.cn/en/getting-started/installation/): per-platform setup and signature verification.
- [Platform Support](https://limedl.zkz098.cn/en/getting-started/platform-support/): supported OS versions, CPU baselines, and restrictions.
- [Configuration](https://limedl.zkz098.cn/en/getting-started/configuration/): every desktop setting and default.
- [Tasks & Concurrency](https://limedl.zkz098.cn/en/guides/tasks/): AIMD, chunk scheduling, priorities, and checksums.
- [CDN Acceleration](https://limedl.zkz098.cn/en/guides/cdn/): edge IP probing and DNS rewriting.
- [URL Rewrite & Custom CDN](https://limedl.zkz098.cn/en/guides/url-rewrite-and-cdn-providers/): mirror rules and provider configuration.
- [BitTorrent Tuning](https://limedl.zkz098.cn/en/guides/bittorrent/): DHT, UPnP, anti-leech, and seeding.
- [CLI & Protocol](https://limedl.zkz098.cn/en/guides/cli/): command line, protocol handlers, and environment variables.
- [Troubleshooting](https://limedl.zkz098.cn/en/guides/troubleshooting/): 403s, BitTorrent, Gatekeeper, tray, and logs.
- [Browser Integration](https://limedl.zkz098.cn/en/ecosystem/browser/): Aria2 Explorer, Camtd, and userscripts.
- [Aria2 RPC](https://limedl.zkz098.cn/en/ecosystem/aria2-rpc/): supported methods, auth, CORS, and client examples.
- [Headless Server](https://limedl.zkz098.cn/en/ecosystem/server-daemon/): NAS, Docker, systemd, and reverse proxy.
- [Security & Verification](https://limedl.zkz098.cn/en/security/): Minisign + ML-DSA-65 signatures and trust boundaries.
- [FAQ](https://limedl.zkz098.cn/en/faq/): compatibility, telemetry, SmartScreen, RPC safety, and backups.
- [Metalink & Mirrors](https://limedl.zkz098.cn/en/advanced/metalink-and-mirrors/): parsing, scoring, leases, and verification.
- [Self-Update Channels](https://limedl.zkz098.cn/en/advanced/self-update-channels/): per-install update paths and rollback.
- [Disk Media & Buffer Tuning](https://limedl.zkz098.cn/en/advanced/disk-media-and-buffer-tuning/): SSD/HDD/network detection and overrides.
- [Expert Settings & HTTP/3](https://limedl.zkz098.cn/en/advanced/expert-settings-and-http3/): scheduler, AIMD, timeouts, and Alt-Svc.
- [Data Backup & Aria2 Import](https://limedl.zkz098.cn/en/guides/data-backup-and-migration/): data layout, migration, and option mapping.
- [Benchmarks](https://limedl.zkz098.cn/en/advanced/benchmarks/): reproducible in-repo measurements.
